entry.title: Dynamics of a Single-Domain Dissipative Magnetic Gyroscope in Electric and Magnetic Fields
entry.summary:
We formulate the coupled spin--rotation dynamics of a single-domain symmetric top ferromagnetic needle (a magnetic gyroscope) in static magnetic and electric fields. The conservative Hamiltonian contains the rotational kinetic energy, the magnetocrystalline and shape anisotropy, the Zeeman energy, the electrostatic energy of the dipole induced in the conducting needle, the linear magnetoelectric coupling, and the relativistic motional (spin-orbit) coupling. Gilbert damping is introduced, and in an electric field, Debye relaxation of the induced electric dipole of the conducting needle also results in dissipation.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #materials-science

entry.title: Quantum simulation of neutral-meson mixing and decay on a reprogrammable photonic processor
entry.summary:
Neutral mesons oscillate into their antiparticles while decaying, so their dynamics is generated by a non-Hermitian effective Hamiltonian which a quantum simulator restricted to unitary operations cannot implement directly. We propose a reprogrammable photonic processor that simulates this open-system evolution through dilation and analyze it at the circuit level. The effective Hamiltonian is reconstructed exactly from measured lifetimes, mass and width differences, and the CP-violation parameter $|q/p|$.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics

entry.title: Causality, determinism and predictability: Probing nature through classical and quantum eyes
entry.summary:
In this article, mainly focussed on students and interested readers, we discuss how the understanding of causality, determinism and predictability is transformed as we move from the classical world view to the quantum description. We first explain how determinism and predictability operate in classical dynamics and outline the notion of causality. A paradigm shift occurs within the framework of quantum mechanics where we have to revisit, and even give up, the notions of determinism, predictability and maybe even strict causality.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter

entry.title: Frequency Multiplexing of Purcell-Enhanced Optically Coherent NV Centers. Integrating optically coherent quantum emitters into nanophotonic structures is key to scalable quantum networks.
entry.summary:
Integrating optically coherent quantum emitters into nanophotonic structures is key to scalable quantum networks. Realizing them with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond is hindered by the degradation of optical coherence accompanying nanofabrication. Here, we overcome this challenge by integrating multiple NV centers into a monolithic diamond photonic crystal nanocavity while preserving near-lifetime-limited optical coherence.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics

entry.title: Variable-length MDI QKD under source imperfections and local randomization over horizontal links
entry.summary:
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides security guarantees that hold despite device imperfections and finite-size effects. We address these challenges in measurement-device-independent (MDI) QKD, combining its intrinsic untrusted detection with an imperfection model for Alice's and Bob's sources via fidelity bounds. We establish variable-length general security under the Marginal-constrained Entropy Accumulation Theorem (MEAT), estimating the relevant Rényi entropies through conic optimization.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics #rust

entry.title: Strange-Metal Magnetotransport without a Strange-Metal Ground State. Strange metals display a linear-in-temperature resistivity, $ρ_{xx}\sim T$, and a quadratic inverse Hall angle, $\cotΘ_H\sim T^2$.
entry.summary:
Strange metals display a linear-in-temperature resistivity, $ρ_{xx}\sim T$, and a quadratic inverse Hall angle, $\cotΘ_H\sim T^2$. These seemingly universal laws are often attributed to quantum criticality, yet no controlled theory realizes both at an asymptotic zero-temperature fixed point, and experimentally they persist only over finite temperature windows. Here, we show that these properties can arise from an intermediate critical regime that does not govern the ground state.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #combinatorics

entry.title: Pair distribution function oscillations at electrostatically stabilized nanocrystal surfaces reflect nanocrystal lattice periodicity
entry.summary:
Nanocrystals (NCs) stabilized electrostatically by short, multivalent inorganic ligands exhibit rich interactions and phase behavior believed to hinge on the configuration of ions at the NC surface, yet these molecular details have not previously been measured. Here we use double-difference pair distribution functions (ddPDFs) of total X-ray scattering to determine the configuration of Sn$_2$S$_6^{4-}$ ligands on PbS NCs suspended in multivalent electrolyte. The measured ddPDFs exhibit a $\sim$3-$\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ wavelength oscillation that extends $\sim$10 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #materials-science #post-quantum

entry.title: Unique continuation for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian
entry.summary:
We prove a unique continuation property for eigenstates of the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian, viewed as functions of the electron configuration with values in the spin-photon space. The vector potential may lie in $L^6_\mathrm{loc}$, with its divergence, curl, and the scalar potential in $L^p_\mathrm{loc}$ for some $p>2$. As an application, we prove a Hohenberg-Kohn theorem at positive coupling strength: the spin-summed ground-state density and combined current density determine the external potentials up to a gauge transformation and an additive constant.

Source: arXiv Analysis, PDEs & Probability (AP, PR, NA, OC) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats #quantum-computing #logic
